misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen record linking each forecast’s specification and issuance-time evidence cutoff to its matured outcome could make prospective evaluation possible. The supplied material does not establish that this would have changed any decision or prevented a forecast error.
misses.decision_reference: existing_evidence_gap_registry.items.EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE: forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs are documented as missing.
misses.decision_relevance: Without the original forecast and timing provenance, the supplied target-time settlement prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or whether a forecast miss occurred.
misses.miss_description: Forecast specifications and issuance-time evidence cutoffs are absent. The settlement records provide target-time prices, but cannot be matched to a documented prior forecast; therefore no decision failure is demonstrated.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent, preventing ex-ante alignment and miss assessment.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence supplies target-time BTC/ETH mark prices (for example, EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5 and EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36), but the repository evidence explicitly says these cannot be assessed against absent forecast specifications and are not portfolio results.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
